implementation: One zero-C FP16 WMMA estimates the full signed16 dot. All BF16-derived integer cores are exactly representable in FP16; arbitrary signed16 values are not substituted. Eight packed low16 products recover the exact residue and simultaneously supply signed per-term discarded remainders. The conditional nearest residue-class lemma has half-spacing32768 and rejects ambiguous midpoints, nonfinite values and unsupported ranges. The116-byte row contains original BF16 inputs, FP16 cores, packed magnitudes and metadata; no larger row is required. Original encoding exceptions, sequential canonical carries and normalization remain; rejected cases use original scalar-float or integer fallback. Three16/32/64-column schedules share scalar ownership through LDS and publish only one float per cell.
correctness_scope: The recovery lemma is exact only under its explicit native-error condition. Host tests prove neither that condition for all gfx1151 inputs nor an inherited PV bound. Native generated core checks observe maximum error448 with no recovery failures, and full generated/captured scores compare raw bits to original complete canonical GPU computation plus independent CPU dots. Finite comparisons are not a universal hardware arithmetic proof. All scores include masked slots and every warmup/measured attempt; guards, unused output tails, original operands and all GPU row encodings are checked. Original model capture provenance is attached. q8192 repeats1023 original rows and is not a real model prompt or a new GB10 token result. No reference output is used as a candidate compute input.
timing_scope: One warmup and three completed measurements per slab, with variant order rotating across slabs. Query encoding is inside each candidate query timer; one key encoding is added separately. Selected prepared QK includes its Q/K preparation. Allocation, reset and validation are outside component timers; guarded process wall is attached. This component contains no probabilities, PV, model startup or token generation.
decision: Keep the modular route isolated. All raw score checks pass, but the fastest modular complete QK is558.3247ms versus selected273.8064ms at q7169, and733.4245ms versus352.2923ms for the q8192 extension. Reducing four matrix products to one does not offset scalar compensation and transport costs. A separate original-input CPU classification finds that narrowing core headroom from7 to3 increases encoding-exception pairs from221326 to3436375 across1048576 groups; this is diagnostic coverage, without a narrower native implementation or timing. Do not integrate either hypothesis based on these results. Pursue a structural reduction in total canonical arithmetic rather than another matrix-count-only change.
